instruction: Given a goal and two solutions, identify the correct one.

Goal: How to Make Apple Roses
Solution 1: To make apple roses, layer thin apple slices onto the top half of a rectangular section of puff pastry brushed with apple jelly and cinnamon sugar so that the edge of the apple slightly hangs over the edge of the pastry. Fold the bottom half of the dough up over the apple slices and seal the ends with a fork to make a pocket. Then roll it up tightly to make the rose shape. If the apples start to slide out, just push them back in gently.

Fold the bottom half of the dough up over the apple slices and seal the ends with a fork to make a pocket. Then roll it up tightly to make the rose shape. If the apples start to slide out, throw them away.
output: To make apple roses, layer thin apple slices onto the top half of a rectangular section of puff pastry brushed with apple jelly and cinnamon sugar so that the edge of the apple slightly hangs over the edge of the pastry. Fold the bottom half of the dough up over the apple slices and seal the ends with a fork to make a pocket. Then roll it up tightly to make the rose shape. If the apples start to slide out, just push them back in gently.
